notes.title: Hints & Bonus chapter update
notes.notes:
- New chapter that complements the main plot of the game, revealing the past of the protagonist.
- Completely redesigned hint system that tracks all the player's actions and gives out information and actions necessary to advance through the story
- Fixed bugs and errors causing crashes in the game systems

notes.title: Tiny Room Stories: Town Mystery Release
notes.notes:
It's time to be a real detective.

 "Hello,
I cannot entrust the paper with the details, but you must urgently come to me in Redcliffe.
The situation is getting out of control, the consequences can lead to disaster

Peter Stone "

After reading the letter from your father, you immediately hit the road.
The city is completely empty.
Where have all the residents gone?
What happened to your father?
This is what you have to find out.

The game is available on Steam with a release discount of 10% until March 5
